input.circles: Immutable Circle(center, radius); point circles permitted; finite nonnegative radius<=1e100
input.line_segment_points: Nondegenerate Line or possibly point Segment; triangles may degenerate
input.tolerance: Used for classification except overlap_area; explicitly configured units/scale

output.intersections: Circumference: 0/1/2 points or infinite for identical positive circle; coincident point circles one point
output.tangents: 0..4 Lines or infinite; count nullopt means infinite, inside-point tangent_points empty; point-circle degeneracies defined
output.triangle_circles: optional<Circle>, nullopt if collinear/degenerate under policy
output.centers: 0/1/2/infinite; repeated point and positive radius infinite
output.overlap: Closed-disk overlap area, NOT circumference intersection count

constraints.coordinates: Float: finite |x|,|y|<=1e100; integer: |x|,|y|<=1e9. Out-of-domain inputs throw invalid_argument.
constraints.numeric: Integer predicate/squared-distance operations exact within bound; floating operations approximate, with long double intermediates; no exact floating kernel. Underflow and near-degenerate topology are not certified. No fast-math.
constraints.ownership: Inputs borrowed for call and not mutated unless explicitly stated; returned coordinates owned; no implicit I/O or global mutable state.
constraints.threading: Concurrent calls may share read-only input; caller must not write input during a call.
constraints.errors: Invalid domain throws invalid_argument; constructed coordinates outside +/-1e100 or nonfinite scalar result throw overflow_error; detectable distinct-point squared-distance underflow throws underflow_error; allocation/size may throw.
constraints.history: No persistence, branching, snapshots, rollback, undo or redo. Ordinary value copying is not persistent storage.

complexity.space: O(1), arrays of <=2 points or <=4 lines; no heap allocation

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative owned payload/working peak lower bound only; excludes input, allocator overhead, headers and stack; zero for data-dependent branches, not zero actual memory.

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in docs/algorithms/geometry.circle.md; floating correctness conditional on numeric predicates; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Regression and degeneracy cases; random integer/float comparisons; closest/diameter quadratic oracles; rectangle all-edge oracle; circle membership/tangency properties
